dedupe_keys.name: national bureau of statistics tanzania building census 2022 tbc basic statistics reports national and regional with ward level counts of buildings by use storeys condition and access to tanesco electricity other electricity water toilet and access road

description: Tanzania's National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) ran a Building Census alongside the 2022 Population and Housing Census and has published a national basic statistics report, a Kiswahili edition and a report for each region of the mainland and Zanzibar. Each regional report counts buildings by use, type, number of storeys, construction status, occupancy and condition, and by basic services, and its annex tables repeat these counts for every council and ward. The basic services tables give, per ward, the number of buildings connected to TANESCO grid electricity, using other electricity such as solar or generators, and with water, a toilet and an access road. The Dar es Salaam report counts 913,707 buildings; in Ubungo Municipal Council 159,225 of 216,188 building units had TANESCO electricity and 117,704 had water. Format and access: free PDF reports; population census microdata are catalogued separately on the NBS NADA portal. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables sit in PDFs and must be extracted, and some tables count building units, not buildings. Simulation uses: ward-level building stock and storey counts for hazard exposure, and grid and water coverage for service planning. Related records: the Kenya 2019 census household amenities volume.
